metadata.notes: The ACE trigger's test on mGBA: a save after frlg.ace_setup (0x0351 in Box 3 slot 1, a Pokémon in Box 1 slot 1: MIMIEN) whose 14 box names hold the bag-prep code for Master Balls (docs/design/FRLG-ACE-Execution.md). Starts facing Route 4 Pokémon Center's PC and ends there, 50 Master Balls withdrawn.

checkpoint.title: The code run by the double swap: MASTER BALL x999 in item storage, 50 withdrawn

events.why: The code writes PC item slot 30: fewer than 30 items stored.
The Pokémon in Box 1 slot 1 (MIMIEN) to Box 3 slot 2, then 0x0351 shifted with it twice: the second shift runs the box names.
The code's item: MASTER BALL x999 in the item storage.
The quantity box set to 50 and withdrawn: 949 stay in the PC.
